text: Kingsmoor FC builds an attack from their own defensive area on the left side, intercepting the ball near their penalty box. The play moves steadily forward down the left flank with a series of passes across midfield and into the final third. Quinlan strikes the ball with his foot and scores, putting Kingsmoor FC 2-0 ahead at the 12th minute. [#211] [#216] [#218] [#220] [#222]
